reader.requirement: At --std 85, an END-WRITE written after a WRITE statement (with or without the END-OF-PAGE / NOT END-OF-PAGE phrases) ends that WRITE's scope: statements after it are not part of imperative-statement-1/2, a nested WRITE's END-WRITE closes the most recent unterminated WRITE (§1985:IV.6.4.3), and an END-WRITE matching no WRITE is refused.

edition-consulted.switches: END-WRITE reserved-word row: reserved at 85, 2002, 2014 and 2023 alike
refuses the 2002 WITH LOCK / WITH NO LOCK phrase a 1985 WRITE ... END-WRITE must not carry (COBOL0900); not on the END-WRITE path itself

reader.edition-search: grep END_WRITE|EndWrite|END-WRITE over src *.cs: only the reserved-word row and generated parser; the grammar rule writeStatement takes END_WRITE? at every edition.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the two witnesses exercise END-IF scope termination, not END-WRITE; nothing in them writes a WRITE with END-OF-PAGE ended by END-WRITE, a nested WRITE, or a stray END-WRITE

probes.printed: WRITE ... AT END-OF-PAGE ... NOT AT END-OF-PAGE ... END-WRITE inside IF/PERFORM: 'EOP AT n' then 'AFTER END-WRITE n' for n=1..4; 'PLAIN END-WRITE 00'; WRITE PR AT EOP ADD 1 TO N END-WRITE ADD 5 TO N -> N 6; a conditional WRITE in IF ended by ELSE -> EOP2, ELSE not taken
probes.expected: GR11: the statements after END-WRITE run outside the phrase; IV.6.4.3: the next phrase of the containing statement ends an unterminated WRITE

probes.printed: N 71 (outer EOP +1, inner WRITE EOP +10 ended by its END-WRITE, +20 still in the outer phrase, outer END-WRITE, +40)
probes.expected: §1985:IV.6.4.3: each END-WRITE terminates the most recently preceding unterminated WRITE -> 71

probes.printed: error COBOL0306: unexpected 'END-WRITE'. END-WRITE appears without a matching WRITE statement.
probes.expected: a second END-WRITE matches no WRITE and is a syntax error

probes.printed: error COBOL0900: a record-lock phrase (WITH LOCK / WITH NO LOCK ...) requires COBOL-2002 (targeting COBOL-85)
probes.expected: the 1985 WRITE format has no lock phrase before END-WRITE: refused

citations.check: OK  §1985:VII.4.7.4 GR11  (4.7.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR11
OK  §1985:IV.6.4.3  (6.4.3 Scope of Statements)  the text is in the clause

reader.notes: Scope termination is purely syntactic: writeStatement ends in END_WRITE? and the phrase bodies are statementBlocks, so the parse tree carries the scope and no edition switch touches it. Catalog GR11 is the Amendment 2 renumbering of the printed GR10.
